claim: Tracked .agent memory and working chronicles must not embed ephemeral scratch path literals — repo_hygiene flags them like workstation home paths and blocks PT CI.

decisions.notes: PT #320 CI failed when saga notes embedded a scratch-path literal instead of a neutral worktree label; use neutral worktree labels in memory.
